    split = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    candidates = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(split) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]

    cells = [(r, c) for r, c, v in candidates if v == color]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[split+1:]]
    target = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    tr0, tc0 = min(r for r, c in target), min(c for r, c in target)
    th = max(r for r, c in target) - tr0 + 1
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    above, below = tr0-sh, max(r for r, c in target)+1
    above_fits = above >= 0
    below_fits = below+sh <= len(out)
    if above_fits and not below_fits:
        y = above
    elif below_fits and not above_fits:
        y = below
    elif len(shape) > len(target):
        y = above
    else:

    for dr, dc in shape:
